text:
ida: Quick sync: design for a low-friction v1->v2 migration path. We want tenants to be able to (a) preview risk, (b) run a cheap sanity replay against a curated prompt set, and (c) understand quota/billing translation. Ideas?

ton y: Love the replay idea. Instead of full traffic probes, provide a "golden-replay" of 500 representative prompts (per-project) that we run deterministically against candidate models. Gives fast signal with low cost.

bez: Nice. For routing rules: prefer explicit pin > model header > tagged routing policy. Introduce per-route "compat-tag" that lets teams opt some routes into lenient fallback while keeping others strict.

infra-sam: Implementation: add `compat_tag` to route config and emit `routed_version` + `route_policy` in events. Probes will use `X-Golden-Replay: <id>` header to keep telemetry separate.

ida: Console should show a single "compat-score" (0-100) computed from golden-replay pass rate, sampled live mismatch rate, and eval-suite result. Color-coded but not alarmist.

ton y: Score computation note: weight golden replay 60%, sampled live 30%, unit tests 10%. Show the components so teams can drill down.

billing-bot: Billing guidance: invoices reflect executed model. When tokenization differs significantly, we'll supply a `token_adj_factor` so Console can show an "anchored estimate" that maps current spend to projected spend. Estimator endpoint will return a string like: "+12% (tok_adj=1.08)".

bez: For quotas, translate v1 units to v2 with the `token_adj_factor` and show both numbers side-by-side: "Current quota: 1M v1 tokens (~=920k v2 tokens)." Also surface if quota units are incompatible.

infra-sam: Telemetry plan: add fields `compat_score`, `golden_replay_id`, `routed_version`, `route_policy`, `billing_exec_model`, `token_adj_factor`. Log golden-replay diffs for up to 500 samples per run (PII scrubbed).

ida: UX: a compact card per-route showing: compat-score, estimated cost delta, quota translation, and a "Run golden-replay" button. Clicking runs it async and adds an entry to the run log.

ton y: Also add per-route sticky policy: "Allow fallback for this route" or "Strict: surface 409 on mismatch". Default to "Allow fallback" for non-critical routes.

bez: For SDKs, add response headers: `X-Routed-Version: v2.2026-03` and `X-Compat-Score: 86` when the request passes through compatibility logic. Helps integrators detect silent changes.

billing-bot: We will expose `estimate_anchor(project, candidate)` endpoint returning `delta: +xx%`, `tok_adj`, `confidence: high/med/low`. Console uses that for the cost card.

infra-sam: Safety-net: add a per-tenant automatic rollback policy that triggers when route-level error rate exceeds baseline by configurable pct for N minutes. Console UI can toggle and set thresholds.

ida: Audit: every golden-replay run creates an audit entry with human text: "2026-03-20 11:12 - Golden replay run by ida (id=gr-77) - pass 482/500". Keep 90-day retention.

ton y: For the golden prompts, customers can provide their own curated set or use our suggested seeded set. We hash and store prompt fingerprints; we do not retain plaintext unless tenant opts in.

bez: ML ask: provide daily compact dump of failed replay pairs (request/response diff) to s3 with 14-day retention; scrub user ids and truncate long inputs.

infra-sam: Will implement scrubber rules: hash user ids, remove emails, truncate >600 chars, redact known PII patterns.

ida: Small copy proposal for Console card: "Compatibility: 86 — Golden replay pass rate 96%. Estimated cost change: +12% (confidence: med). Run replay or simulate live micro-cohort." Short and neutral.

ton y: Micro-cohort option: allow a tiny live run (default 0.05%) for a short window. Only run if compat_score >= threshold set by tenant.

billing-bot: Reminder: if live micro-cohort runs, those requests are billed at executed model rates. Console will warn before enabling.

bez: QA checklist: 1) headers emitted for routed requests; 2) compat_score components computed & stored; 3) golden-replay scrubber works; 4) estimator endpoint matches billing table; 5) rollback toggle invokes admin API.

ida: Owners: tony -> golden-replay infra + scoring, bez -> route policy + headers, infra-sam -> telemetry + scrubber, billing-bot -> estimator. I'll open an issue and attach mock. Thanks! :thumbsup:

notify-bot: Note: deployment scheduled: feature/golden-replay -> staging (sha: f00ba r) :rocket

ida: One more: add a tiny "what-if" tool that shows projected quota burn for a sample of 1k requests using token_adj_factor. Helps teams sanity check quotas.

ton y: Good call. We'll add it under the replay results panel.

ida: Great work. I'll drop PR links and the mock into this thread when ready.
